## Contribution type

- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Learning resource

## Summary

What are you proposing, and why is it useful?

## Files or sections affected

List the paths or pages you expect to change.

## Proposed approach

Describe the change. If you are adding a resource, explain why it is free, accurate, and maintained.

## Validation

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Sumit-tech01/DevSphere-Community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I have read the [Community Guidelines](https://github.com/Sumit-tech01/DevSphere-Community/blob/main/community/COMMUNITY_GUIDELINES.md).
- [ ] I have checked for duplicate work.
- [ ] I have verified any external links.
- [ ] I have removed secrets and personal data.
- [ ] I can open a pull request for this change.

## Additional context

Add examples, references, or screenshots if useful.
